The '''GS-100 salvage ship''', more commonly known as a '''Trandoshan scavenger ship''', was a [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] vessel, designed to navigate debris fields in the wake of [[Space warfare/Legends|space battles]], picking up salvageable parts to sell for scrap.

==Characteristics==
[[File:RaiderEngines-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|200px|The engines of a GS-100]]
A durable vessel capable of dealing with dangerous spatial anomalies, it required a small crew to operate, which allowed the owner to share the profit from salvage with fewer associates.

==History==
A notable GS-100 was the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], owned by [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]].<ref name="DOAD" /> Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA11">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> he used it to scavenge the debris field after the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]]<ref name="DOAD" /> and later to bring the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]].<ref name="DOTD">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>

Another GS-100, the [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|''Raider'']], was seen scavenging the wreckage after the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]] and the crew picked up a wounded [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], hoping to ransom her to to her employers. However she swiftly [[Death/Legends|killed]] them with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and took the ship to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. This ship was later used to transport Ventress, along with [[Karis/Legends|two]] [[Naa'leth/Legends|other]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to [[Mission to Serenno (Nightsisters)/Legends|assassinate]] [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]]. When the attempt failed, the ship was used to bring them back to Dathomir.<ref name="NS">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>
